module password.strength
  purpose: Classify password strength.

public type Strength is one of
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong based on length and character variety.
  example: classify(password: "abc") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdefgh1!") is Strong

  let length be password.length
  let has_letter be password.matches(raw "[a-zA-Z]")
  let has_digit be password.matches(raw "[0-9]")
  let has_other be password.matches(raw "[^a-zA-Z0-9]")
  let variety_count be
    if has_letter then 1 otherwise 0 end +
    if has_digit then 1 otherwise 0 end +
    if has_other then 1 otherwise 0 end

  if length is at least 12 and variety_count is 3 then
    return Strong
  otherwise if length is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
```
